verdict_basis: The six-unit semantic decomposition is coherent, preserves owner boundaries, and recomposes into every capability named by the approved specification. It is not yet mutation-handoff ready because required receipt writes are outside every SWU write_scope, staged postimage and candidate outputs are declared only as directories rather than exact target paths, and the acceptance-critical validation matrix is described by labels rather than complete executable command contracts. These gaps prevent independent review of the actual mutation and evidence boundaries without changing the intended six-unit topology.

first_unit_narrowness.reason: A complete read-only freeze of the closed 13-type denominator is the smallest reversible trust-building step. A per-type or partial freeze would not disprove omission, duplicate identity, stale predecessor, or route-resurrection defects across the denominator and would not safely admit either repair seam.

MTC-B03 correctly forbids a waiver, but the Plan must bind the exact currently failing command and expected repaired outcome so a different red failure cannot be silently classified as the known one.

The two requests are correctly distinct, but their schemas, exact common candidate digest field, independent response validators, and admission-false invariant are not machine-bound in the SWU contract.

proposed_splits.proposal: Prefer one validation SWU with an exact ordered child-command ledger and one final conjunction verdict. Split into child command-runner units plus a no-new-evidence aggregator only if the execution substrate cannot preserve every child exit and artifact independently inside one Task Session.
proposed_splits.reason_not_mandatory: The candidate promotion claim is indivisible: every required child must pass, and partial validation has no successor authority.

merge_rejections.reason: RQ1 semantic ownership and FMP provider-contract ownership, changed paths, failure codes, and proof denominators are independent.
A proof-first D04 failure must stop before the complete matrix and may open a separately governed representation gap.
Validation evidence must exist before candidate identity is frozen; candidate assembly must add no new validation claim.

dependency_review.logical_graph: SWU-MTC-001 -> {SWU-MTC-002 -> SWU-MTC-003, SWU-MTC-004}; {SWU-MTC-003, SWU-MTC-004} -> SWU-MTC-005 -> SWU-MTC-006
dependency_review.machine_graph: SWU-MTC-001 -> SWU-MTC-002 -> SWU-MTC-003 -> SWU-MTC-004 -> SWU-MTC-005 -> SWU-MTC-006
dependency_review.finding: The prose declares a logical fork/join while SWU-MANIFEST.json and SWU-CONTRACTS.json encode only the serialized chain. Serial execution is safe, but the machine dependency projection should either preserve the semantic fork/join plus a separate scheduling order or the Work Pack should explicitly state that dependencies include scheduling prerequisites. Do not claim exact graph parity while these representations differ.

recomposition.capability_count_note: The Define SPEC contains five named capability rows, not four. The Plan has four task wrappers, but tasks are not the specification capability denominator. This receipt therefore proves recomposition to all five source capabilities and rejects any later four-capability completeness claim unless the source specification is separately changed.

residue.gap: Expand each SWU write_scope to the exact unit-created product/evidence files, Task Session receipt, precloseout receipt, and Invoke Refresh closeout receipt, with present/absent baselines.
Replace directory-only staged/candidate scopes with exact output path mappings for SWU-MTC-002, 003, 004, and 006.

Bind complete executable validation contracts, especially SWU-MTC-005: ordered argv, cwd, environment/toolchain, timeout, expected exit or typed result, staged-view inputs, output receipt path, cleanup, and original-failure preservation.
Reconcile the logical fork/join with the serialized machine dependency graph without changing semantic owners or the one-session-at-a-time scheduling policy.
Use the five capabilities explicitly named by SPEC.md in the final recomposition statement; do not substitute the four Plan task wrappers for the capability denominator.

observations: Enum remains reused from WP-RMT-001 rather than recreated.
Only the old WP-RMT-002 execution route is superseded; predecessor evidence remains intact.
RQ1 is treated as decided binding evidence, not reopened semantics.
FMP provider rebinding remains separate from Operation semantic rebinding.
APE evidence remains profile-candidate-local and cannot prove core closure or admission.
Rondelli and Victor remain distinct reviewers of one exact digest; candidate creation cannot self-approve.
All six units and closeouts stop before live apply, admission, promotion, release, or external effect.

required_repair_without_topology_change: Enumerate exact staged postimages, evidence outputs, candidate artifacts, and receipt paths in every SWU contract.
Add present/absent baselines for every create/update target.
Materialize exact structured validation contracts and a child-result ledger whose final verdict is the conjunction of all required results.
Represent logical dependencies and serial scheduling as separate fields or make their deliberate collapse explicit and validator-checked.
Regenerate this Proposer receipt and run the Balancer after final Plan bytes stabilize.
claim_ceiling: Independent Standard-budget Distill proposal over the supplied Define, Design, and Plan artifacts. It proves that the six semantic units and owner boundaries are coherent and identifies execution-contract blockers. It does not repair or accept the Plan, run Implementation Readiness, select a Task Session, mutate product bytes, create an admission candidate, approve owners, apply live targets, or change authority.
